تتبادروا (form VI)
# تَتَبَادَرُوا (tatabādarū) /ta.ta.baː.da.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# تُتَبَادَرُوا (tutabādarū) /tu.ta.baː.da.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
